description: List safe, retained integration activity for this organization. Intermediate workflow artifacts stay private, while this projection records provenance, counts, selected fields, and subscription capacity source. Results are cursor-paginated. Supply at most one of provider, connection_id, kind, or status; use next_cursor to continue. Requires 'discovery' scope.

connection_id.description: Filter to one organization integration connection

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from an earlier response

name: list_integration_runs

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: List Integration Runs
